Your signature appears here: type a name, a company, an email or a phone number.

    Add it to your mail

    Gmail
    1. Copy signature here.
    2. In Gmail: Settings (the gear) › See all settings › General › Signature › Create new.
    3. Paste into the box, then Save changes at the bottom.
    Outlook (Windows and Mac)
    1. Copy signature here.
    2. In Outlook: File › Options › Mail › Signatures (Mac: Outlook › Settings › Signatures), then New.
    3. Paste into the box and Save. Choose it for new messages and replies.
    Outlook on the web
    1. Copy signature here.
    2. Settings (the gear) › Account › Signatures › New signature.
    3. Paste, name it and Save.
    Apple Mail
    1. Copy signature here.
    2. Mail › Settings › Signatures, choose the account, then +.
    3. Untick "Always match my default message font", then paste.

    Pictures show only from a web address that anyone can open (your website, say). Social links are words, not icons, so every mail program shows them.
